release_checks.claim: Linux and Windows execute the same backend, frontend component, build and browser gates
The production bundle completes a browser workflow against the pinned real Image runtime without browser API mocks

acceptance_items.claim: Root navigation opens the new-task workbench with searchable task history
Prompt, file type, size and MIME errors are rejected next to the task intake controls
Initial images, PDF and text assets have bounded concurrent upload progress, retry and cancellation
A DRAFT survives refresh and locks all later uploads after intake submission
Master messages and plan revisions persist and manual mode creates no running instances before confirmation
Automatic mode skips only final confirmation and retains Provider, credential and Adapter gates
Rename, pin, archive and restore update presentation state without changing execution state
The board projects one stable logical WorkItem across instance replacement and retry history
Running work wins over parallel approval and all board mappings are deterministic
The plan view orders stages and dependencies and reports the unavailable PPT boundary truthfully
An Image WorkItem opens only its server-approved current instance workbench with controlled recovery
The embedded Agent surface contains no duplicate workbench chat and keeps specialist interaction in the iframe
Active and stable projections use three- and five-second cadence and hidden tabs pause polling
Writes retain idempotency, actor and expected-revision envelopes and conflicts remain recoverable
Supported desktop widths, keyboard focus, reduced motion, error announcements and WCAG 2.1 A/AA checks pass
